why: A waxed copper tile laid in the floor under `anchor/exit`, and a bolt struck at the exit. The block a bolt strikes is the one under its mark, and when that block is copper the game scrapes it back and walks a random path through the copper beside it scraping more; when it is a lightning rod the game powers it. Either is a world write the game rolls, which no proof of this engine can state. The build names the strike and the block. It declares no unit: `lightning` is bound by the valley-site overlay, whose strike lands on the court's own paving. The remedy is the mark, or a block the bolt leaves alone under it. The vacuous direction: lay stone under the same mark and the gate goes green over the struck block it still reads, which the binding line counts.
